title: Wire Settings capability toggles into Alpha runtime policy
goal: Make the existing read/write/execute/network Settings toggles authoritative for default runtime authorization so Alpha workspace Skills can run when the user explicitly enables the required capabilities.
context: The composition root currently defaults to DefaultPolicyEvaluator, which denies all non-read-only actions regardless of the capability toggles displayed in Settings. Replace the default with a settings-backed evaluator while preserving explicitly injected policies and existing workspace safety checks.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass workspace path validation, protected-file checks, secret detection, size limits, read-back verification, or cancellation.
Do not silently grant destructive actions; require explicit approval.
Do not enable network capability unless its Settings toggle is enabled.
Do not weaken explicitly injected policies or fail-closed behavior when policy is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Default composition policy honors the existing permissions.capability.* Settings values.
Read, write, execute, and network are individually checked; network remains disabled by default.
Destructive actions request approval rather than being automatically allowed.
Unit tests cover enabled workspace write, disabled write/network, and destructive approval.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert this scoped policy wiring change if capability settings regress; preserve explicit policies and all workspace safety checks.
